# ParseFolder localization can return before its folder completion work

The feedback migration puts a localization error return before FinishUpAfterParseFolder in the indexer's completion lambda. The accepted source retains that order. StoreIndexer stores this callback as std::function<void(nsresult)> and ignores any lambda result, while FinishUpAfterParseFolder clears parsing state, notifies the reparse listener and sends folder-loaded. If formatting fails, the callback skips that folder completion work; this is a checked conditional control-flow limit, with no injected formatting failure or user-visible hang reproduced.

Scope: Local folder reparse completion.
